verses.text: Meanwhile Boaz went up to the town gate and sat down there. Just then the family protector he had mentioned came along. Boaz said, "Come over here, my friend, and sit down." So he went over and sat down.
Boaz took ten of the elders of the town and said, "Sit here," and they did so.
Then he said to the family protector, "Naomi, who has come back from Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our relative Elimelek.

I thought I should tell you about it and suggest that you buy it in front of these people sitting here and in front of the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, do so. But if you will not, tell me, so I will know. No one has the right to do it except you, and I am next in line." "I will redeem it," he said.
Then Boaz said, "On the day you buy the land from Naomi, you also take Ruth the Moabite, the dead man's widow, so that the dead man's name stays with his property."
At this, the family protector said, "Then I cannot redeem it, because I might put my own property in danger. You redeem it yourself. I cannot do it."

In earlier times in Israel, this was the custom for redeeming and trading property: to make it final, one person took off a sandal and gave it to the other. This was how agreements were made official in Israel.
So the family protector said to Boaz, "Buy it yourself." And he took off his sandal.
Then Boaz said to the elders and all the people, "Today you are witnesses that I have bought from Naomi all the property of Elimelek, Kilion and Mahlon.

I have also taken Ruth the Moabite, Mahlon's widow, as my wife, so that the dead man's name will stay with his property. Then his name will not disappear from among his family or from his hometown. Today you are witnesses!"

Then the elders and all the people at the gate said, "We are witnesses. May the LORD make the woman who is coming into your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the family of Israel. May you do well in Ephrathah and be famous in Bethlehem.
Through the children the LORD gives you by this young woman, may your family be like that of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah."
So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife. When he made love to her, the LORD enabled her to become pregnant, and she gave birth to a son.
The women said to Naomi, "Praise the LORD, who today has not left you without a family protector. May he become famous in Israel!
He will give you new life and take care of you in your old age. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and who is better to you than seven sons, has given birth to him."
Then Naomi took the child in her arms and cared for him.
The women living there said, "Naomi has a son!" And they named him Obed. He was the father of Jesse, the father of David.
This is the family line of Perez: Perez was the father of Hezron,
Hezron the father of Ram, Ram the father of Amminadab,
Amminadab the father of Nahshon, Nahshon the father of Salmon,
Salmon the father of Boaz, Boaz the father of Obed,
Obed the father of Jesse, and Jesse the father of David.
